english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for bringing people, groups, or states together.
Use this mainly when organizations, groups, or political factions join forces under a formal arrangement.

examples.english: The company will ally with several universities to conduct this research.
examples.traditional: 公司同幾間大學聯合做呢個研究。
examples.jyutping: gung1 si1 tung4 gei2 gaan1 daai6 hok6 lyun4 hap6 zou6 ni1 go3 jin4 gau3

examples.english: Several political parties unite to form a new alliance.
examples.traditional: 幾個政黨聯合組成新聯盟。
examples.jyutping: gei2 go3 zing3 dong2 lyun4 hap6 zou2 sing4 san1 lyun4 mang4
